SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
"One's true feelings cannot be hidden regardless of 
lip service."

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: - Ralph Waldo Emerson.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
This is the Kousaka household, located somewhere 
in Chiba.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
In this residence, worried maidens assemble, 
seeking answers from the master of life, every night.

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT: Now then, I wonder who tonight's guest will be...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Pardon me for intruding!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...This is my house, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Well, I'm not gonna worry about the trivial details, 
no worries!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Lately, there's talk about a Life Counseling Master 
that will resolve all sorts of trouble in no time at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I heard that I could meet him if I came here, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: So you made it here, young girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Geh... D-Dad...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: W-Why are you here!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Is there something wrong with me being in my own 
house?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Y-You're right, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
In other words, I am the aforementioned Life 
Counseling... Sensei.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
[font_size=28]What's with that!? Dad is the Life 
Counseling Master!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
...Don't address me by that. I don't like being called 
"Master".

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: So, what should I call you then...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Well. For the time being, address me as "Sensei".

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Sensei...? Why?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I'm your senior in life, so using "sensei" is befitting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Hmm...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Th-There's no other motive behind it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: ...So you're into that kind of play.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
A-Anyway, in this situation, our relationship is not one 
of parent and child.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I will turn a blind eye and hear you out.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Don't ever forget that this is the relationship 
between a sensei and his pupil, a master and his 
disciple.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Well, it's definitely easier to consult with you about 
this if I treat you as a stranger.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Yes... just like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I won't hold back with my questions then...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I-I'm gonna ask, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: It's fine. Say it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What do you think of a little sister who's a brocon?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: [font_size=44]Pfft!!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: W-What did you say, all of a sudden...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Ah... maybe, Da... Sensei, do you know what brocon 
means?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
I'm not proficient with Western languages, but I 
know that much at least.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Brocon... A brother complex. In other words, 
expressing strong feelings and attachment towards 
one's brother, correct?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Are you in that kind of situation?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: N-Not at all...! Why would I be involved in that...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I just want to know, assuming there was such a 
girl, what's the opinion of said girl from a guy's 
perspective...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
For example... a girl reuniting with her 
lifelong-separated older brother, she makes his 
meals to please him, takes a bath with him...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I really think she's admirable and just lovably 
cute~

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: But... won't other people think it's disgusting?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Mmm... Isn't it fine?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If the person in question doesn't mind, there's no 
need to bother about the quibble of others.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Really!? You really think so!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
I think it also depends on her age. There's no 
problem if she's still a child.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Age... No matter how old she is, a little sister is a 
little sister, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
That might be true, but it depends on certain 
factors.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Just how old is the girl you're talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Th... The setting is 18-years-old and above...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: What...? What do you mean?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
There are 18-year-old little sisters that go into the 
bath with their older brother?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: There... There just might be. The world is vast.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Even if there is... that little sister who goes into the 
bath with her older brother at that age, consider 
the older brother.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If he's a healthy man, he'll naturally have some 
modesty to reject her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: So, it's okay if they're younger?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Younger?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
For... For example, a little sister who is in middle 
school and an older brother in high school...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=26]There's barely any difference! Use some 
common sense, common sense.[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Are you saying that's admirable and lovably cute?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Uuh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Th-They're both desperate! They have to be! In 
order to regain their lost time together...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
That's not what I'm referring to. I'm saying that the 
situation you speak of lacks common sense.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
No matter what kind of feelings they have, there 
should be other ways to express it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I-In that case, how is a little sister supposed to 
convey her feelings to her beloved Onii-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...That's why I asked, isn't this about yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I-I said it isn't!! D-D-D-Don't make any weird 
misunderstandings!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
What I want to know is, how a so-called typical and 
normal brocon little sister is supposed to get her 
Onii-chan to understand her feelings?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Isn't it better if she just tells him directly?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [font_size=28]Huuuuuh!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: What if she gets hated for it?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If the other person is a so-called typical and normal 
older brother who's a siscon, he won't hate her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Th-There's no way there's someone like that!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
So, is there an example of a typical and normal 
little sister who's also a brocon?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
In the first place, she's hesitating because she is 
evaluating whether it's normal or not.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If you treat it as a type of romance, what she has 
to do should be the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: B-But, just now, you said it's abnormal...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Certainly, abnormal it may be. But, whether it's 
normal has no relation to her feelings of liking 
someone.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
You can't help liking what you like... That's also 
something my children taught me.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
She should just say what or who she likes, without 
hesitation.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
If she's seized with fear over being abnormal, then 
she has no right to like anything or anyone.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Is that girl close to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Y-Yeah... kinda...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Umm... she consulted me since I also have an older 
brother, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I don't know the full details, but she seemed pretty 
worried over it.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Then, you should just tell her something similar.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
That girl probably refuses to accept that she has a 
brother complex. That's why she's so worried 
about what other people think.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Ah, ahahahaha... Th-That might be true.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
However... don't forget to use proper discretion. Tell 
her that too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah... I'll do that...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Hmph... so she's gone.
Was that story really about someone else...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: Today's moral lesson!!

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
[font_size=33]If you fall in love, do so without 
holding yourself back!! [/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
--And so, Daisuke has guided the path of another 
lost maiden. Let us meet on another moonlit night.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: This reminds me...

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT:
Honey... What do you think about Kyousuke's and 
Kirino's relationship lately?

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
It's normal. They do talk a bit more than they used 
to.

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: I-I see. That's fine then. Ahahaha...

SPEAKER: SPK_YOSHINO
TEXT:
...Dear, if you don't trust your daughter because of 
that consultation, doesn't that disqualify you as a 
master?

SPEAKER: SPK_DAISUKE
TEXT: ...Mmm.
